contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: Talk to HomeLoop on WhatsApp, phone or email about an order, selling an item, or installation. We serve customers across the UAE.
contact.intro: Questions about an order, selling an item, or installation? We usually reply on WhatsApp within working hours.
contact.a1: Cash on delivery or on collection. No card needed.
contact.q2: Do you deliver to my emirate?
contact.a2: We deliver across the UAE. The fee depends on your city and is shown before you order.
contact.a3: Yes. Add installation or assembly when you order; the price is shown in the order form.
contact.a4: If an item doesn't match its description, you can refuse it at the door, or tell us on WhatsApp within {hours} hours of delivery. We collect it free and refund you in full, including delivery and service fees.
contact.q5: Can I collect my order myself?
contact.a5: Yes. Choose pickup in the order form and collect it from our warehouse during working hours, with no delivery fee.
